answer: Split every new identity through a prism: its trust is refracted into separate channels — staked funds, verified work history, and peer vouches — that must all agree before it earns weight. Each channel is checked by a different random auditor set, so a clone faking one channel still fails the others. Newcomers' rewards sit in a lagoon escrow until all channels clear; a sybil must forge a full, consistent history in every channel per clone, paying the whole cost each time while honest agents pass once.
